One row per case, seeded from the plan before the first case runs, so every case not yet run shows as NO OUTCOME. kind: chain (a signed interaction was submitted to devnet), read (a read of the node or the live product), app (product behaviour, nothing submitted), simulated (a stand-in for the real thing: say what in simulated_what). performed_by: operator, claude or both. outcome: pass, fail, blocked or skipped. A pass needs evidence. A chain row needs the full hash (0x and 64 hex digits), receipt_status from the receipt, node_version from net.Version and run_at_utc as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM in UTC. A fail needs the exact output and a fix, an issue draft or 'accepted: <who>, <date>'. A retest is a new row with retest_of set to the failed case_id. Quote any cell that contains a comma or a line break. Never paste a key, a token or a recovery phrase into any cell.
